questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at this exact speed.
The highest speed you can legally drive on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed you can legally drive on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed allowed on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes only.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are only for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when you get in a car to drive?
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel based on your seat position.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads:

options.text: Always drive at the speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Turn on your signal as you move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet ahead on residential streets before changing lanes.

questions.explanation: Other cars are often hidden in your blind spot, so look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets or 5 seconds on a freeway.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines. You may:

options.text: Cross these lines only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross these lines to pass other vehicles if no cars are coming.
Cross these lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross these lines only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You can only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: It is legal to drive faster than the speed limit when passing another vehicle.
questions.explanation: You cannot exceed the speed limit at any time, including when passing another vehicle.

questions.question: The $500 uninsured motor vehicle fee gives you basic liability insurance coverage.
questions.explanation: The $500 uninsured motorist fee does not provide insurance. It only allows you to register and drive your vehicle in Virginia for one year.

questions.question: What is a No zone?

options.text: The blind spot of a large truck or vehicle
An area for motor vehicles only

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large truck or vehicle
questions.explanation: No zones are large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas for long.

questions.question: What should car drivers know about large trucks?

options.text: They can stop faster than passenger vehicles.
They need the same space to turn as passenger vehicles.

questions.explanation: Large trucks have big blind spots in front, on the sides, and in back. Do not stay in these areas. Because trucks are larger and heavier, they need more space to turn and stop than regular cars.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road where you can see traffic coming toward you.

questions.question: During an emergency roadside stop, you do not need to use your parking brake.
questions.explanation: Always use your parking brake during an emergency roadside stop. Turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop for other vehicles or pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text to confirm this.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering. They alert drivers to unexpected road conditions ahead.

questions.question: In cities and towns, where are U-turns allowed?
questions.explanation: In cities and towns, U-turns are only allowed at intersections.

questions.question: When turning left on a multi-lane, one-way street, where should you start?

options.text: In the middle of the intersection.

questions.explanation: Always start a left turn from the left lane on multi-lane streets.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.
Follow the detour to avoid dangerous conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid dangerous conditions.
questions.explanation: These signs show a change in traffic flow due to work ahead. Follow the marked detour route.

questions.question: You are backing out of your driveway and see children nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Honk your horn so they hear you.
Get out and check behind your car to make sure it is clear.
Tell the children to stay away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out and check behind your car to make sure it is clear.
questions.explanation: Always get out and look behind your vehicle before backing up, especially when children are near. Do not rely only on mirrors. Check the entire area behind your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay for other drivers to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two people is more balanced than one with one rider.
You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
Motorcycle brake lights turn on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need the full width of a lane. Your vehicle must be completely in the left lane before you pass a motorcycle.

questions.question: Why should you be alert to motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
Motorcyclists are less skilled than other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and hard to see. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge their distance and speed. Always be careful around motorcycles.

questions.question: Is it legal to transport children under 16 in a pickup truck bed if it has a camper shell?
questions.explanation: It is illegal to transport children under 16 in the bed of a pickup truck, even with a camper shell.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead allows only one-way traffic.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop at a red light or slow down at a yellow light.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mark school zones. Watch for children and pedestrians in these areas.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the road slants toward the left. This means:

options.text: There is an intersection just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You will be required to turn left just ahead.

questions.explanation: A solid line on the side of the road marks its edge. When this line angles toward the center of the road, it means the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: When following other cars across railroad tracks with no signals or gates:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing.
You must have enough space to cross the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must have enough space to cross the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before driving onto railroad tracks, make sure you have enough room to cross completely without stopping. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing any tracks.
